summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding the issuance of an unsecured promissory note for $191,475 to its sponsor, HWei Super Speed Co. Ltd., to fund an extension of its deadline to complete a business combination. The note is non-interest-bearing, matures upon business combination, and is forgivable if no deal occurs. It is convertible at $10.00 per unit at the sponsor's option. This is a routine SPAC extension financing and not a standalone special situation event.
